quality.refusal_verbatim: Quality gate failed: score 67.4 < 80.0. Video appears desaturated (estimated: 1.7%). Consider increasing saturation.
quality.notes: kinocut's overall score is the mean of the 5 GATING checks (brightness, contrast, saturation, audio_levels, color_balance); temporal_motion is ADVISORY (ADVISORY_CHECKS) and does not weight the score — v2 fixes it anyway. Signalstats YLOW/YHIGH are the 10th/90th luma percentiles (interdecile range), verified empirically: each frame needs ~10% of pixels at both extremes to score; flat matte UI surfaces pin both percentiles to the surface luma.
quality.saturation_ceiling_analysis: The saturation check requires SATAVG >= 10% of range. v2 content measures: light app captures 0.4-0.9%, midnight captures 1.6-2.2%, engineered cards ~1.2-1.4% (design-system brass/verdict accents cover too little area to move a whole-frame mean), overall 1.31% pre-grade. The color_balance check penalizes chroma 3 points per % r/b deviation while saturation gains only 2 points per % — a global warm/cream grade or >2x eq saturation is measured net-negative or identity-breaking. An honest >=80 would require ~80% engineered card time with saturated ink walls, i.e. no longer the live-capture ledger demo the brief mandates. Honest plateau for this content type: ~65-75.
quality.ceiling_projection: with every remaining honest lever at maximum (contrast ~50, saturation ~8 at eq 2.0, cb ~97): ~70-75 overall — still REFUSED
